title: MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 200 Posts
content_html:
Brief Summary: Looking for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 200 Posts? Check out complete notification details including total posts, eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, important dates, and step-by-step apply online link.

MP Employees Selection Board (MPESB) ne Patwari Recruitment 2026 ka notification release kiya hai. Is recruitment drive ke tehat 200 posts hain jo ki PwD (Divyangjan) ke liye reserved hain. Ye jobs Land Resources Management Department, Gwalior ke liye hain. Agar aap Madhya Pradesh ke permanent resident hain aur aapke paas graduate degree aur valid disability certificate hai, toh ye aapke liye ek accha mauka hai. Application online bharne ki prakriya 4 August 2026 se shuru hogi aur 18 August 2026 tak chalegi. Toh, aap is mauke ko mat chhodiye!
